description: This source file is a module that injects code into the React component registry to enable mounting, updating, and unmounting React components within a testing environment, specifically designed for Playwright testing with React components. It handles JSX transformation, manages React root instances, and provides functions to mount, unmount, and update React components dynamically.

methods.name: isJsxComponent
methods.description: Checks whether a given object is a JSX component used in Playwright's internal representation.

methods.name: isJsxFragment
methods.description: Checks whether a given type is a Playwright JSX fragment.

methods.name: __pwRender
methods.description: Transforms Playwright's JSX representation into React.createElement calls for rendering.
